entries.name: Lion (Gorham trademark)

entries.means: Mexican assayed silver of about 1948 into the 1960s. Museum records show a different number for each Taxco workshop (9 Aguilar, 16 Margot de Taxco, 30 Spratling), so the number most likely identifies the maker.

entries.name: Kostroma town mark
entries.looks_like: A shield divided in four, with a cross and a crescent.
entries.date_note: Rosenberg: Beschauzeichen 1834-1878. Rosenberg's spelling: Kostroma.
